meta.name: campaign-planner
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "plan an influencer campaign", "build a campaign blueprint", or "launch a product with creators"; produces campaign objectives, platform and influencer-tier strategy, content requirements, a phased timeline, budget allocation, and KPI targets. Not for writing individual creator briefs — use brief-generator; not for the overall product-launch plan (tiering, calendar, press, community day) — use launch-tier-planner, which hands this skill the creator lane. A launch request that does not mention creators routes to the launch discipline, not here.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划创作者营销活动的完整蓝图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要系统规划创作者营销活动并设定KPI。
copy.tagline_en: Plan a complete blueprint for influencer campaigns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically plan influencer campaigns and set KPIs.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你提供的品牌、预算、受众和时间，生成一份完整的网红营销活动计划，包括目标、平台策略、内容要求、分阶段时间表、预算分配和KPI指标。
howto.when: 当你要求“策划网红营销活动”、“制定活动蓝图”或“借助创作者发布产品”时触发。

say.text: 帮我策划一个新品运动鞋的网红营销活动，预算5万，目标受众是Z世代。
say.note: Claude 会生成一份完整的活动计划。

say.text: 为我的护肤品牌制定一个季度网红合作计划，预算10万。
say.note: Claude 会输出包含时间线和预算分配的计划。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can generate a complete influencer campaign plan based on your brand, budget, audience, and timeframe, including objectives, platform and influencer-tier strategy, content requirements, phased timeline, budget allocation, and KPI targets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "plan an influencer campaign", "build a campaign blueprint", or "launch a product with creators".

say_en.text: Plan an influencer campaign for a new sneaker launch with a $50K budget targeting Gen Z.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a full campaign plan.

say_en.text: Create a quarterly influencer partnership plan for my skincare brand with a $100K budget.
say_en.note: Claude will output a plan with timeline and budget breakdown.
